title: MAML-generated Mirror code initialization
hypothesis: A support-set encoder initializing a Mirror code, followed by low-dimensional refinement, improves few-shot query quality over zero-init Mirror and matches full MAML at lower amortized bytes.
mirror_coordinate: 2D per-task Mirror code initialized by support-set encoder
logical_multiplicity: fast adapted functions over task distribution
controls: support encoder Mirror init plus refinement

task.type: paired few-shot 8D Givens-orbit regression as MA-442

success_gate: Encoder-init Mirror matches full MAML within 1.10x NRMSE, beats zero-init Mirror in >=2/3 fresh worlds, and lowers amortized bytes at N=20 without higher query compute.
failure_gate: No quality gain over zero-init Mirror or encoder amortization removes storage benefit.
boundaries: Same aligned linear task family as MA-442 for paired comparison.
No natural task or nonlinear-network evidence.
Encoder bytes are amortized explicitly at N=1,20,100.
